headline: Three banks will give loans to those affected by the earthquakes
summary: Venezuela's Ministry of Economy and Finance authorized BDV, the Treasury and BDT to grant loans under the 'Venezuela Renace' program for those affected by the earthquakes.
why: Government-linked banks channel public credit programs, and their lending capacity affects reconstruction spending and household credit in the affected areas.
